# Insulation Contractor Houston

> Licensed insulation contractor serving North Houston, TX. We install spray foam, blown-in, injection foam, and attic insulation for residential and commercial properties. Serving Cypress, Spring, The Woodlands, Conroe, Kingwood, Humble, and Tomball.

## About

Insulation Contractor Houston is a fully licensed and insured insulation company based in Cypress, TX (77429). We are a sister company to USA Insulation of North Houston, specializing in attic insulation upgrades, spray foam encapsulation, and energy-efficiency improvements for homes built in the 1980s–2000s that still have original, under-performing insulation.

- **Phone:** (832) 291-2738
- **Email:** info@insulationcontractorhouston.com
- **Address:** Cypress Farms Ranch Rd, Houston, TX 77429
- **Hours:** Monday–Saturday, 8 am–6 pm
- **License:** Fully insured contractor
- **Service area:** North Houston — Cypress, Spring, The Woodlands, Conroe, Kingwood, Humble, Tomball

## Services

- [Spray Foam Insulation](https://insulationcontractorhouston.com/spray-foam-insulation) — Open-cell and closed-cell spray foam for attics and crawlspaces
- [Injection Foam Insulation](https://insulationcontractorhouston.com/injection-foam-insulation) — Wall cavity insulation without removing drywall
- [Blown-In Insulation](https://insulationcontractorhouston.com/blown-in-insulation) — Loose-fill fiberglass or cellulose for attics
- [Attic Fan Installation](https://insulationcontractorhouston.com/attic-fan-installation) — Solar and electric attic ventilation fans
- [Insulation Removal](https://insulationcontractorhouston.com/insulation-removal) — Full attic removal for damaged or pest-contaminated insulation
- [Commercial Insulation](https://insulationcontractorhouston.com/commercial-insulation) — Metal buildings, warehouses, and office spaces

## Pricing Context

Typical installed insulation costs in North Houston TX (2025–2026):
- Blown-in attic insulation: $1.00–$2.50/sq ft
- Open-cell spray foam: $1.50–$3.50/sq ft
- Closed-cell spray foam: $3.00–$7.00/sq ft
- Injection foam (walls): $2.00–$5.00/sq ft
- Insulation removal: $1.00–$2.00/sq ft
- DOE recommended R-value for Houston (Climate Zone 2): R-38 to R-60

Free estimates available Monday–Saturday. Call (832) 291-2738 or visit the contact page.
